messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for dedicated-inference-pool-eu-west — high p95 tail latency (>1200ms). Trigger: latency_threshold. Link: https://pager.company/incident/2890012345

sam (oncall): grabbing this now. Looking at console and traces.

lee: noted. If you want to hand off after triage I can own the next 30m. In EU until 13:00 UTC.

sam (oncall): thanks @lee. Quick check: `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-pool -o wide | grep eu-west` shows several pods at 3/3 ready but one node showing CPU spike.

maria: customer signal: support reported slow responses for ACME Corp in EU region around 12:08 UTC. They're seeing ~2s per-request and some timeouts. Raising priority if confirm.

sam (oncall): creating a temporary bridge — https://meet.company/bridge/2890012345 (will post notes). Taking initial metrics: queue depth for dedicated-inference-pool-eu-west spiked to 280; avg token latency up ~3x.

ops-sre: adding runbook link: https://docs.company/runbooks/dedicated-pool-latency. First steps: check autoscaler events, GPU throttling, and prefix cache pressure.

sam (oncall): autoscaler events show a few `scaleDownBlocked` entries, and there's a recent node provisioning delay from cloud provider (eu-west-3). Suspect capacity churn.

lee: if it's node churn we should consider temporary routing to secondary pool (dedicated-inference-pool-eu-central) — can we flip a canary route? @maria can you confirm no regulatory constraint for ACME?

maria: ACME is fine to route EU->EU-CENTRAL for now, they asked for a heads-up though. I'll DM their support lead.

sam (oncall): ok will open a canary route: `route set dedicated-inference-pool -> eu-central (20% spill)` applied. Monitoring for errors now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route change applied (spill: 20%). Observability link: https://observability.company/alerts/2890012345

lee: latency dropped ~40% in the metrics after spill. Queue depth slowly decreasing. I'm happy to take over ownership — @sam I can own until full recovery and follow up with postmortem.

sam (oncall): handing ownership to lee. I'm leaving the bridge, will be reachable if it re-escalates. 

sam (oncall): notes -> `Handed to lee at 12:22 UTC. Initial cause: node provisioning delay causing transient capacity reduction. Mitigation: route spill to eu-central; monitoring.`

lee: acknowledged, taking primary. I'll keep the bridge open and notify ACME once stable. Expecting to close incident in ~30m if no regressions.

maria: customer notified and appreciates quick mitigation. Keeping them on standby for a full timeline postmortem.

ops-sre: add follow-up: schedule node pool upgrade check & alert tuning to avoid aggressive scale-down during provisioning windows.

lee: will file a short incident ticket and assign to infra-team for the node provisioning root cause. Ticket: https://tickets.company/INC-2026

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident transitioned: owner=lee, status=mitigated (monitoring).

lee: closing thread here — leaving ownership and ticket open for infra follow-up. Will post a summary + RCA draft in #postmortems later today.

sam (oncall): thanks all. :thumbsup:
